question: What happens to knowers whose realization is still unsteady?
premises: Knowers are divided into two kinds.
One kind has realization marked by trembling or instability.
Death can complete what was incomplete in life.
inference: Therefore knowers whose realization trembles clearly become Śiva at the end of the body.
uncertainties: kampra is doctrinally compressed; it suggests instability rather than mere fear.
plain_english: But among the knowers there are two kinds, distinguished by trembling and non-trembling realization. Those whose knowledge still trembles clearly become Śiva at the end of the body.
